input: Sign up for a wilderness survival skills weekend

gold.taskTitle: Sign Up for a Wilderness Survival Skills Weekend
gold.taskDescription: Find and register for a wilderness survival skills weekend course or program.

questions.title: What geographic area should the course be located in?
questions.description: Determine the preferred location or region for the wilderness survival weekend.

questions.title: Do you have a target date or timeframe in mind?
questions.description: Identify when the user wants to attend the course.

questions.title: What is your current experience level with survival skills?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a complete beginner, has some basics, or wants to advance existing skills.

questions.title: Are you signing up solo or with other people?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is an individual registration or a group booking.

questions.title: What is your budget for the course fee?
questions.description: Establish a price range to filter suitable programs.

questions.title: Are there specific survival skills you most want to learn?
questions.description: Identify priority topics such as fire-making, shelter building, navigation, foraging, or first aid.

questions.title: Do you require any accessibility or physical accommodations?
questions.description: Note any physical limitations or special requirements that would affect course suitability.
